decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted and numbered 2013(AR)97-01, 2013(AR)97-02, 2013(AR)97-03 received 05/08/2013 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the ground floor premises is occupied).

Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted for restaurant (A3)/ hot food takeaway (A5) purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times Monday to Friday, Sundays and Public Holidays - 08.00 - 23.00, Saturday 08.00 - 23.30. All customers shall have left the premises no later than 30 minutes after the closing times listed above.

Condition : 4 - The rating level of noise emitted from fixed plant on the site, shall be lower than the existing background noise level by 10dB. The noise levels shall be determined at the nearest noise sensitive locations. The levels shall be determined according to BS4142:1997.
Condition : 5 - There shall be no speaker or stereo system affixed to the party walls or ceiling within premises at any stage.
Condition : 6 - The extractor flue should not be used between the hours of 23.30 and 07.00 any day of the week.

Condition : 7 - The use hereby permitted for a restaurant and hot food take-away purpose shall not be begun until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.
description: Change of use from A1(Retail) to A3 (Restaurant) / A5 (Take-away) incorporating the installation of flue duct on rear elevation.
